summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 36 (inline-upload-progress) to generate executable PLAN.md files with integrated research and verification.
summary.outcome: Research, validation strategy, and two plan files (36-01, 36-02) were created and committed to the correct branch. The verification loop found 2 blockers and 3 warnings, triggering a plan revision on 36-01-PLAN.md.

repo: Phase 36 is 'inline-upload-progress' — replaces modal upload popup with inline rows in FileList, sorted alphabetically alongside existing files.
GSD branch naming was misconfigured: config.json used `phase-{phase}-{slug}` template but the project convention is `feat/{slug}` (enforced by commitlint). Config was fixed.
The project uses a feat/ branch naming convention that must align with commitlint rules — branch names like `phase-36-inline-upload-progress` are invalid.
Phase 36 planning produced 2 plans in 2 waves: 36-01 (upload store refactor for per-file tracking) and 36-02 (UploadListItem component + FileList wiring + old popup deletion).

code.finding: Branch template fields changed: phase branch from `phase-{phase}-{slug}` to `feat/{slug}`, milestone branch from `{milestone}-{slug}` to `feat/{milestone}-{slug}`.
Revised by planner after checker found 2 blockers and 3 warnings in verification iteration 1/3.

workflow: GSD plan-phase workflow: Research → VALIDATION.md → Plan → Verify (up to 3 iterations) → done.
When a background planner agent completes, branch hygiene should be verified before spawning the checker — plans need to land on the correct branch.
Fast-forward merging (`git merge --ff-only`) is the safe way to move GSD-generated commits from a stale branch to the canonical feature branch without rewriting history.

friction: GSD commit tooling automatically created `phase-36-inline-upload-progress` instead of `feat/inline-upload-progress`, conflicting with the project's commitlint branch naming rules.
Three stale branches (`phase-36-inline-upload-progress` and variants) had to be manually cleaned up after migrating commits.
Branch config bug was only discovered mid-session when the user noticed the wrong branch name — the misconfiguration was pre-existing and silent until now.
open_items: Verification loop is still in progress — checker found 2 blockers and 3 warnings, planner revision of 36-01-PLAN.md was underway at transcript end. Iterations 2-3 may still be needed.
Execution of the finalized plans has not started — next step is `/gsd:execute-phase 36-inline-upload-progress` after verification passes.
